  | .node l _ r => size l + 1 + size r

  | node l v r => simp [size]

Qed.

inductive Tree where

namespace Tree

  | leaf => leaf

  | leaf => 0

Inductive Tree : Type :=
| leaf : Tree
| node : Tree -> nat -> Tree -> Tree.
Fixpoint size (t : Tree) : nat :=
  match t with
  | leaf => 0
  | node l _ r => size l + 1 + size r
  end.
Fixpoint mirror (t : Tree) : Tree :=
  match t with
  | leaf => leaf
  | node l v r => node (mirror r) v (mirror l)
  end.
Theorem mirror_mirror (t : Tree) : mirror (mirror t) = t.
Proof.
  induction t as [| l ihl v r ihr].
  - reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite ihl, ihr. reflexivity.
Qed.

From Stdlib Require Import NArith ZArith String Lia.
Open Scope string_scope.
Inductive Tree : Type :=
| leaf : Tree
| node : Tree -> nat -> Tree -> Tree.
Fixpoint size (t : Tree) : nat :=
  match t with
  | leaf => 0
  | node l _ r => size l + 1 + size r
  end.
Fixpoint mirror (t : Tree) : Tree :=
  match t with
  | leaf => leaf
  | node l v r => node (mirror r) v (mirror l)
  end.
Theorem size_mirror (t : Tree) : size (mirror t) = size t.
Proof.
  induction t as [| l ihl v r ihr].
  - reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite ihl. rewrite ihr. lia.
Qed.

programs.source:
From Stdlib Require Import NArith ZArith String DecimalString Lia.
Open Scope string_scope.
Inductive Tree : Type :=
| leaf : Tree
| node : Tree -> nat -> Tree -> Tree.
Fixpoint size (t : Tree) : nat :=
  match t with
  | leaf => 0
  | node l _ r => size l + 1 + size r
  end.
Fixpoint mirror (t : Tree) : Tree :=
  match t with
  | leaf => leaf
  | node l v r => node (mirror r) v (mirror l)
  end.
Theorem mirror_mirror (t : Tree) : mirror (mirror t) = t.
Proof.

From Stdlib Require Import NArith ZArith String DecimalString Lia.
Open Scope string_scope.
Definition show_N (n : N) : string := NilEmpty.string_of_uint (N.to_uint n).
Definition show_nat (n : nat) : string := NilEmpty.string_of_uint (Nat.to_uint n).
Definition show_Z (z : Z) : string := NilZero.string_of_int (Z.to_int z).
Definition classify (n : Z) : string :=
  if (n <? 0)%Z then "negative" else if (n =? 0)%Z then "zero" else "positive".
Definition describe (n : N) : string :=
  let doubled := (n + n)%N in
  show_N n ++ " doubled is " ++ show_N doubled ++ " (" ++ classify (Z.of_N doubled - 10) ++ ")".
Definition main : list string :=
  describe 3 ::
  classify (-4) ::
  nil.

Eval vm_compute in main.

inductive Expr where
  | num : Nat → Expr
  | neg : Expr → Expr
  | add : Expr → Expr → Expr
  | flag : Bool → Int → Expr

def eval : Expr → Int
  | .num n => Int.ofNat n
  | .neg e => -(eval e)
  | .add a b => eval a + eval b
  | .flag b i => if b then i else 0

theorem eval_neg (e : Expr) : eval (.neg e) = -(eval e) := by simp [eval]

theorem eval_add (a b : Expr) : eval (.add a b) = eval a + eval b := by simp [eval]

def main : IO Unit := do
  IO.println s!"{eval (.add (.num 2) (.neg (.num 5)))}"

namespace Geo

inductive Point where
  | pt : Int → Int → Point

namespace Ops

def shift (p : Point) (d : Int) : Point :=
  match p with
  | .pt x y => .pt (x + d) (y + d)

end Ops

end Geo

namespace Draw

inductive Path where
  | stop : Path
  | step : Geo.Point → Path → Path

def length : Path → Nat
  | .stop => 0
  | .step _ rest => length rest + 1

def last : Path → Geo.Point
  | .stop => .pt 0 0
  | .step p .stop => p
  | .step _ rest => last rest

end Draw

theorem shift_zero (x y : Int) : Geo.Ops.shift (.pt x y) 0 = .pt x y := by simp [Geo.Ops.shift]

def main : IO Unit := do
  IO.println s!"{Draw.length (.step (.pt 1 2) (.step (Geo.Ops.shift (.pt 0 0) 3) .stop))}"
